details: Sometimes while recording with the VRC camera and OBS, sometimes something happens where the streaming camera will disconnect its communication with OBS or turn the streaming camera into the regular picture camera. This doesn't happen frequently but happens more often when switching worlds or using the countdown timer to take a screenshot with the streaming camera. This makes things annoying when you have to go back and check your footage to see if it recorded with the regular picture camera or what you recorded is really what you intentionally wanted recorded using the streaming camera while also making sure OBS recorded the right view and didn't reset from streaming camera view to headset view. I figured the camera changing from regular picture camera from streaming camera could be a VRChat bug, but I am also aware it could partly be an issue with OBS when it resets from stream camera view to VR headset view. I thought it was best to make an icanny just in case it was a bug and if it happens to others.
title: Strange issue where streaming camera changes to regular camera or disconnects from OBS
